_style.warm_real: Cinematic film still, shot on 35mm Kodak Vision3 500T, visible fine film grain, low-saturation warm grey palette, soft natural light, shallow depth of field, photorealistic, restrained and quiet mood. No text, no letters, no watermark, no logo. No visible face; any person is seen from behind, in silhouette, or only as hands.
_style.noir: Black-and-amber film noir still, lit only by one old desk lamp: a warm tungsten pool of light on the desk falling off into deep black, high contrast, shallow depth of field, 35mm film grain, photorealistic. No text, no letters, no watermark. No visible face.
_style.old_man_hands: an old man's hands with age spots and thick knuckles, cuffs of a worn grey wool sweater, an old stainless-steel-band mechanical wristwatch on the LEFT wrist
_style.old_woman_hands: an old peasant woman's hands with cracked weathered skin, cuffs of a dark-blue coarse cotton padded jacket
_style.lamp: an old brass banker's desk lamp with a green glass shade
_style.envelope: an old kraft-paper envelope, top folded over twice, faint illegible pencil marks on it
_style.jar: a dark-brown coarse stoneware jar, its mouth covered by an upside-down white bowl with a blue rim

shots.prompt: Extreme wide shot at blue-grey dusk in heavy snowfall: a small village on the Loess Plateau of northern Shanxi, China — rammed-earth houses and cave dwellings (yaodong) cut into terraced loess slopes, thin snow on the ridges, a thread of smoke from one chimney. One small window glows warm yellow. In the lower middle of the frame, very small, the back of a person with an old canvas shoulder bag stands before a weathered wooden courtyard gate. Vast muted sky, painterly stillness.

Close-up inside a dim northern Chinese farmhouse, the corner of a heated brick kang bed covered with an old felt mat. On it sits {jar}. {old_woman_hands} rests on top of the upturned bowl, about to lift it. Cold blue window light from the left mixes with a warm glow from inside the room. Dust in the air, textures of clay, cotton and enamel.

Close-up of {old_man_hands}, holding {envelope} open with its mouth facing up, as if about to receive something poured into it. Background: a softly blurred farmhouse kang with a patterned quilt, warm dim interior light, cold window light rim on the knuckles.

Close-up from above at a slight angle: {old_man_hands} turning over a stack of yellowed printed form sheets on an old scratched wooden desk, under the light of {lamp} from upper side. The printed table header is completely out of focus and unreadable. A fountain pen lies nearby.

Traditional Chinese ink-wash painting (shuimo) on textured raw xuan paper, pale diluted ink, large empty areas of paper. Low-angle composition: from the bottom edge of the picture, two hands of an ancient Chinese farmer in loose robe sleeves raise a full drooping bunch of foxtail millet heads toward a horizontal wooden pole under a thatched eave in the upper third of the frame; several bunches of millet already hang from the pole, heads drooping. Elegant brushwork, soft ink bleeding, a few touches of pale ochre. 16:9. No text, no seal, no signature.

Close-up under {lamp}: {old_man_hands} taking off a pair of old reading glasses with thin metal frames, holding them by the temples, above an old wooden desk with a manila file folder and {envelope}. Warm amber light, shallow focus on the glasses and fingers, deep shadows.

Medium shot from behind and to the side: a white-haired old man in a worn grey wool sweater sits at an old wooden desk under {lamp}; his face is turned away and lost in shadow — only his grey-white hair, ear and shoulder are rim-lit. One hand rests gently on {envelope} on the desk. Behind him, in the darkness, faint grey steel shelves full of small kraft envelopes.

Medium shot from behind: a white-haired old man in a worn grey wool sweater stands still at a small window of an old seed storage room at night, head slightly bowed. Outside the window it is snowing in blue darkness; the glass has a thin film of condensation. Warm lamp light inside, steel shelves with kraft envelopes at the edge of frame.

1980s Chinese colour film photograph look (faded Kodak/Fuji stock, warm yellow-green cast, soft grain): on a rutted loess dirt road between dry fields, a young man in a 1980s work jacket rides an old 28-inch black bicycle away from the camera, seen from behind; a canvas bag hangs from the handlebar and a bundle of kraft paper envelopes is tied on the rear rack; dust kicked up behind the wheels; wide open plateau, low sun. No text, no face visible.

1990s Chinese colour film photograph look (slightly faded, soft grain): a middle-aged man with black hair, wearing a grey wool sweater, crouches on the ridge at the edge of a field of ripe foxtail millet, seen from behind and to the side so his face is not visible; he writes in a small notebook resting on his knee; an old stainless-steel-band wristwatch on his left wrist; golden drooping millet heads sway around him; overcast soft daylight. No text.

Modern crisp digital photograph, exactly the same composition as a classic field-notes photo: a white-haired old man in a worn grey wool sweater crouches on the ridge at the edge of a field of ripe foxtail millet, seen from behind and to the side so his face is not visible; he writes in a small notebook resting on his knee; an old stainless-steel-band wristwatch on his left wrist; golden drooping millet heads around him; soft daylight, natural colours. No text.

Inside an old Chinese farmhouse, low-angle shot looking up: {old_woman_hands} lift a bunch of golden drooping foxtail millet heads from the bottom edge of the frame toward a dark wooden roof beam in the upper third of the frame, where several bunches of millet already hang head-down. Warm window light, dust in the air.

Inside an agricultural research station, low-angle shot looking up, same composition as a hanging-harvest photo: {old_man_hands} lift a bunch of golden drooping foxtail millet heads from the bottom edge of the frame toward a horizontal galvanized metal drying rack bar in the upper third of the frame, where rows of millet heads already hang. Soft cool daylight from high windows.

Early spring experimental field in northern China: freshly ploughed soil drawn into neat shallow furrows, pale blue sky far away. A white-haired old man in a worn grey wool sweater crouches at the head of a furrow, seen from behind, holding {envelope}; beside him on the soil stands an old dented tin watering can. Soft cool morning light, a light breeze.

Rough charcoal drawing on a coarse stone-like grey paper surface, heavy grain, only charcoal black and earthy yellow-ochre: around ten thousand years ago on a hillside in North China, a few hunter-gatherers wrapped in animal hides bend among tall wild grasses whose long slender seed heads droop; one of them pinches off a seed head that still clings to its stalk and drops it into a hide pouch. Expressive smudged strokes, prehistoric atmosphere, no faces in detail. 16:9. No text.

Mural painting in the style of a High Tang dynasty Dunhuang Mogao cave wall painting, mineral pigments — azurite blue, malachite green, red ochre, earthy whites — on a mottled, flaking plaster wall with cracks and losses: farmers ploughing a field with an ox in the rain, a man carrying loads on a shoulder pole, rain falling in fine lines from dark rolling clouds, distant layered mountains and mist; full, balanced composition with flowing lines. 16:9. No text, no inscriptions.

Ming dynasty Chinese woodblock print illustration in the manner of the 1637 book Tiangong Kaiwu: pure black ink lines on aged off-white paper, fine dense parallel hatching: on a threshing floor, farmers swing wooden flails to thresh grain and one tosses grain into the air to winnow it, grains flying, simple farm tools, a straw shed. Clean engraved line art, no colour. 16:9. No text, no characters, no seal.

1940s black-and-white documentary photograph, silver gelatin print with heavy grain, scratches and dust: the arched doorway of a yaodong cave dwelling on the Loess Plateau, a woven basket heaped with millet and an old bolt-action rifle leaning against the rammed-earth wall beside it, a cloth door curtain, hard slanting sunlight casting strong shadows. No people. No text.
